title: Local gates on a joint state
objectives: Explain why local unitary gates cannot create entanglement from a product state.
prerequisites: Chapters 3–5: tensor products, complex amplitudes, unitary gates, Born probabilities and measurement bases.

quizzes.question: Which operator applies H to A in |AB⟩ order?
feedback: Correct: the factor positions match the state labels.
A sum is not the local tensor action.

quizzes.question: Can U⊗V entangle a product pure input?
options: Only if Z probabilities are uniform.
feedback: H can create local superposition without entangling.
Correct: it maps u⊗v to Uu⊗Vv.
A histogram does not determine factorization.
